targetCountRule: The target Forms count is exactly the 'should be present' reference list's own item count (28 in every pass documented so far for this classcode/COB combination) — not merely 'delete the should-be-removed list and stop'. After bulk-deleting every present should-be-removed form, count what's left: if it's more than 28, at least one extra auto-attached form (typically a state-specific cancellation/nonrenewal form tied to the risk's filing state, e.g. IL 02 60 for Connecticut, IL 02 82 for Mississippi) must also be identified and deleted. See testing-process-notes.md Rule 8 and quote-option-details.md's 'CORRECTION' section.

steps: Tick the Delete checkbox for every present should-be-removed form (multi-select).

Re-scroll the ENTIRE grid one more time (small steps or keyboard Home/End after focusing a row — mouse-wheel scroll is known to get stuck partway, see testing-process-notes.md Rule 10) and visually re-verify every ticked row is one that was actually intended — clicking anywhere on a row's body (not just its checkbox) silently toggles that row's own Delete checkbox, a confirmed, repeat-offending trap.
Click the red 'Delete Form' button (top of grid, not per-row).
Confirm the 'Please Confirm' dialog (Ok) — wait for it to fully render before clicking.

Re-check the 'Forms [Count: N]' heading. If N > 28, identify the extra unflagged form(s) (cross-check against shouldBePresent once that list is provided, or use the Review Policy → 'Missing Forms' tab as a secondary signal) and repeat the tick/verify/delete steps for it/them.
Click the page-level 'Save' button once the count reads exactly 28.
deletionWorkflow.recoveryIfOverDeleted: If a form is accidentally deleted (count ends up below 28): 'Add More Forms' button → Advanced Filter → Form Code 'Contains' → the exact code → Search → tick its row → 'Add To Quote' (not 'Save' — no button is literally labeled Save in that modal). The re-added form is appended as the LAST row rather than reinserted at its original position — cosmetic only, doesn't affect the Forms count or the Policy Generation PDF's Schedule of Forms. Full detail in testing-process-notes.md Rule 10.
